source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: In [either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), as an attack targets a **DEATH GUARD** unit of yours up to 6" from this model, you can activate this ability. If you do, whenever a melee attack **destroys** a model in that unit before that model has fought in the phase, roll a D6. On a 2+, keep that model on the battlefield: once the attacking unit finishes its attacks, it can fight, and is removed after that. This lasts for the rest of the phase.

trigger.event: attack targets friendly DEATH GUARD unit

effect.eachRecipient: model in targeted friendly DEATH GUARD unit

successEffect: fight after attacking unit finishes its attacks
